We're holding yet another Great War Weekend from April 18, 9:00 am to April 21, 7:30 am UTC!

The following changes are also being made:
・All players will receive match rewards
・Fixed an issue with keep gate announcements

The first match starts today a 9:00 am UTC!

This mode features large-scale combat between up to 48v48 players. Just like a standard 2-Army Battle, you'll want to destroy the enemy team's Core before they destroy yours.

[h3][Other][/h3]

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.30.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

Here are the patch notes for the upcoming update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
[h2]<New Features> [/h2]
[list][*] New features for Custom Battles.
[list][*] Admins can now force Battles to end early.
[list][*] Select this option from the submenu during a Custom Battle.
[*] All players will be returned to the custom lobby after a Battle is forcefully ended.[/list]
[*] Admins can now forcibly move players in Custom Battles.
[list][*] Select forced movement mode to enable moving players.[/list]
[*] Added several features for events.[/list][/list]
[list][*] New Commander Feature.
[list][*] Added Reject Commander Role option.
[list][*] Change this setting on the options screen.
[*] If set to ON, you will not be randomly assigned the role of Commander.
[*] However, you may still be selected if all players in your army have set Reject Commander Role to ON[/list][/list][/list]
[h2]< Improvements & Fixes> [/h2]
[list][*] Made improvements to the Commander feature.
[list][*] When a player who has applied for the Commander Role cannot be found, a Commander will be selected from amongst the top five ranked players in the army who are able to be selected as Commander. (updated April 9th)[/list][/list]
[h2]< Bug Fixes> [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a minor bug on the map Dawn Bridge B.
[*] Fixed issue where battle banners sometimes did not appear when a certain amount of damage was inflicted on the castle gates by catapults or robots.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

notes.title: 🌟 Balance Update Preview🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

The following balance changes will be rolled out in the near future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
[list][*] To make more strategies viable, keep gate durability and rebuild thresholds have been adjusted.
[list][*] Durability: 1400 ⇒ 900
[*] Rebuild Threshold: 1000 ⇒ 1500[/list][/list]
[list][*] Based on how often the Seraphim and Artificer ★5 Cleric titles see use, the following changes have been made to their Ultimates:
[list][*] Sanctuary (Seraphim)
[list][*] Reduced the animation lock after casting to make the skill feel better and adjusted its cooldown, duration, and healing values.
[list][*] Cooldown (s): 90 ⇒ 60
[*] Duration (s): 15 ⇒ 10
[*] Healing: 20 ⇒ 30[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] Turret Wall (Artificer)
[list][*] Made the skill less effective at range by reducing the range of its turrets.
[list][*] Range (m): 50 ⇒ 40[/list][/list][/list][/list]
If you have any feedback regarding this update or other game issues, please let us know.

notes.title: 🌟 Balance Update 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

The following changes are being made in an effort to improve game balance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
[h2]▼Adjustments[/h2]
[b]Keep Gate[/b]
Keep Gate durability has been reduced because the previous value made using ladders as a means of gaining access to an enemy keep more difficult than intended.
[list][*] Durability: 3200 → 2000[/list]
[b]Colossus Form (Centurion Ultimate)[/b]
The duration is being reduced so that Centurions have less impact on the result of a match that goes into overtime. 
[list][*] Duration (seconds): 15 → 12[/list]
[b]Typhon Shield (Typhon Ultimate)[/b]
Typhon Wing’s ability to blow away enemies was proving to have minimal impact on the battlefield because it was too weak. To allow the Typhon to be effective at advancing battle lines, Typhon Wing is being adjusted so that it can no longer be blocked by a shield, and its range and blast distance are being increased.
[list][*] Can no longer be blocked by shields
[*] Blast distance (meters): 9 → 15
[*] Range (meters): 17.5 → 20[/list]
[b]Area Heal[/b]
Area Heal was proving to be less effective than intended when compared to Heal due to the prevalence of Dispel. Area Heal’s cooldown, duration, and heal over time effect are being adjusted so that it provides more healing in a shorter time.
[list][*] Cooldown (seconds): 18 → 20
[*] Duration (seconds): 12 → 8
[*] Heal Over Time (seconds): 10/11.8/13.6/15.4/17.2 → 15/18/21/24/27[/list]
[b]Wind Trap[/b]
Wind Trap’s cooldown and number of uses are being adjusted to give it more strategic flexibility.
[list][*] Cooldown (seconds): 20 → 22/20/20/18/18
[*] Uses: 1/2/3/4/5 → 3/3/4/4/5[/list]
[h2]▼Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a minor known issue with Labyrinth Temple[/list]
If you have any feedback regarding this update or other game issues, please let us know.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

notes.title: 🌟 Balance Update 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
The following changes are being made in an effort to improve game balance.

[b]Keep Gate[/b]
[list][*] Keep Gates are being made repairable because the destruction of a Keep Gate results in the constant need to deal with the threat of enemy intruders, which in turn contributes to making the game feel unfun.
[list][*] Additionally, because the Keep Gate is the last line of defense, its durability is being increased.
[list][*] Durability - 1600 ⇒ 3200[/list][/list][/list]
[b]Barrage[/b]
[list][*] Barrage's burn damage against objects is being reduced due to the excessive impact it can have on a game.
[list][*] Burn Damage vs Objects - 10 ⇒ 5[/list][/list]
[b]Rocket Punch[/b]
[list][*] Rocket Punch's object damage is being reduced because it has made the destruction of gates and siege and artillery weapons easier than intended.
[list][*] Object Damage - 250/287.5/325/362.5/400 ⇒ 200/230/260/290/32[/list][/list]
[b]Judgment Strike[/b]
[list][*] Judgment Strike's ability to deal object damage and burn damage against objects is being removed due to the fact that the Arcane Art can have an excessive impact on the game despite how early it can become available.[/list]
[b]Energy Blessing[/b]
[list][*] Energy Blessing's attack multiplier has been reduced due to the fact that it made dealing with enemies under its effect too difficult.
[list][*] Attack Multiplier ... 1.5/1.625/1.75/1.875/2 ⇒ 1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35[/list][/list]

We've received a lot of game balance feedback from all of you, and we're aware that not everything has been covered. That's because our goal is to provide a fun game experience for all of you, and we're still deliberating how to best accomplish that.

If you have any feedback regarding this update or other game issues, please let us know.

Another effective tactic is to throw the Thunder Trap somewhere out of the enemy’s line of sight and then capture their attention with an attack from another direction, so they don’t notice the trap before it triggers. notes.title: 🌟 Update and Fix 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
We will be updating the game at 6:00 am UTC today to fix a known issue and revert the Sep 3 changes made to Tower capture speed and behavior.

The details are as follows.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Wave Blaster Mage Skill so that it no longer enters a cooldown when it is interrupted by an enemy attack before it can fire.
[*] The time required to capture a Tower has been adjusted for 2-Army and 5-Army Battles. Due to these changes, changes have also been made to how Towers behave.

[list][*] From Enemy Occupied to Neutral:
[list][*] Before adjustments 
[list][*] 1 player...30s 
[*] 2 players...15s 
[*] 3 players...7.5s 
[*] 4 players or more...5s[/list][/list]
[list][*] After adjustment:  
[list][*] 1 player...16s 
[*] 2 players...8s  
[*] 3 players...5.33s 
[*] 4 players...4s 
[*] And so on, for up to 20 players.[/list][/list]
[*] From Neutral to 100% Captured: 
[list][*] Before adjustment: 
[list][*] 1 player...30s 
[*] 2 players...15s
[*] 3 players...7.5s
[*] 4 players or more...5s [/list][/list]
[list][*] After adjustment:
[list][*] 1 player...8s 
[*] 2 players...4s 
[*] 3 players...2.67s 
[*] 4 players...2s 
[*] And so on, for up to 20 players.[/list][/list]
[*] In accordance with the above, changes were made to the behavior of Towers.
[list][*] The Capture Gauge decreases automatically unless it is at 100% (previously 80%). 
[*] You can only Warp to allied Towers that are 100% Captured (previously 80%).[/list][/list]

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.25.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]
Here are the details of the October 7 update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new 5-team battle map "Victory Bell" will be implemented.
[list][*]The number of towers in Victory Bell is five, significantly fewer than in The pentagon (the existing five-team map), making each tower more important, and the key to victory is how well you can keep your towers in place. Also, whereas the pentagon had different terrain and fortress for each team, the terrain and fortress in Victory Bell are similar for all teams.
[*]There are three routes to attack the castle, with a battering ram and siege tower on each of the left and right lanes. The central route has no weapons, but catapults can be used to attack the central route gate. The Special Ops who cover with catapults and the Assault Squad who rush into the castle must work well together to break into the castle.[/list]
[*]Team skills " Hymn of War" and "Battlecry" will be implemented with additional effects for squad members
[list][*]Hymn of War
[list][*]The amount of armor granted to all participants will change depending on the participation of squad members
[list][*]1 member: 25
[*]2 members: 85
[*]3 members: 145
[*]4 members: 200
[list][*]Armor value upper limit 200[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*]Squad member participation grants [Increased Natural Recovery] (buff) to members only when they are not in combat.
[list][*]Without buffs: Warrior and Mage recovery limit 50%, automatic recovery rate 4%/s, time to trigger automatic recovery 10s
[*]With buffs: Warrior and Mage recovery limit 100%, automatic recovery rate 4%/s, time to trigger automatic recovery 5s
[list][*]Values are subject to adjustment.
[*]Buffs are subject to the skill "Dispel".[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*]Battle Cry
[list][*]The duration and level of the buff for the attack power increase buff for all participants will change depending on the participation of squad members.
[list][*] 1 member: buff duration 20s, buff level 1
[*] 2 members: buff duration 70s, buff level 3
[*] 3 members: buff duration 120s, buff level 5
[*] 4 members: buff duration 160s, buff level 7
[list][*] Buff duration upper limit 160s[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] Squad member participation grants the following buffs to squad members only
[list][*] Weapons Move up
[*] Building speed up
[list][*] Duration and buff level do not change depending on the number of members
[*] Buffs are subject to the skill "Dispel".[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] With the addition of squad member effects, the UI display for team skills will be modified[/list][/list]
[*] A "Portal Gate" that only members of the same team can pass through will be added to the Cleric Ult "Turret Wall".
[list][*] No bullet can pass through.
[*] Allied bot and alliance team members cannot pass through[/list]
[*] New products will be added to the shop.
[*] A new function "Treasure Hunt" will be implemented in the shop.
[list][*] This is a new feature that allows you to obtain random items by spending Goldin.
[*] You can acquire a variety of skins, including skins that have been sold in the past.
[*] We will also continue to add skins that can only be obtained through the Treasure Hunt.[/list]
[*] A new feature "Survey" will be implemented.
[list][*] A QR code linked to an external survey page will be displayed in the game.
[*] A survey field will be added to the Questionnaire section of the top menu to take you to the survey page.[/list][/list]
[h2]Improvements & Changes[/h2]
[*] Bot Commander's instructions have been adjusted.
[*] Key help for switching pages has been added along with the addition of scrolling operations in the store
[*] The icon display in the shop has been adjusted and changed to make it easier to see which categories and products are on sale.
[*] When an ally receiving Energy Blessing attacks an enemy, an effect and SE have been added to the reticle to indicate that the ally is attacking the Energy Blessing activator.
[*] Changed so that when there is an allied player (including oneself) inside the Cleric skill “Sphere Shield”, the Cleric will receive Valor points if the Sphere Shield is hit by an enemy's long-range attack.
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Fixed an issue in which all icons indicating the color of the model displayed next to the item name of modern warfare equipment were displayed in gray.
[*] Fixed an issue where guarding the alternate projectiles of the " Turret Wall" ballista could cause the ballista to not accept any action other than guarding.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Turret Wall" where it was possible to climb and stand on it from the side.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented matching from starting if you left the party at the same time you entered the matching.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause unintended UI and behavior when attempting to activate the "Turret Wall" in certain positions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Turret Wall", when placed on a breakable scaffold, would sometimes remain floating in mid-air without breaking even if the scaffold was no longer there.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed a robot to destroy the "Turret Wall".
[*] Fixed a bug in Ritual Valley A where the blue team BOT would repeatedly respawn in Tower A.
[*] Steam version only: Fixed a bug in which switching the control type on the character slot selection screen did not switch the key helper for skills.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the microphone to automatically unmute when going to Results with the microphone muted.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ult "Phoenix" sometimes did not slip past enemy bullets
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Warrior Pose 27 from being the correct pose.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the number of occupied towers under the minimap was not updated when the tower was 80% occupied and in acquisition status.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the dialog box for specifying the number of boost items and color powders could not be displayed when trying to purchase them in the event store, and the items could not be purchased in bulk.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the targets of non-commander members did not switch after the tower was occupied when the commander sent a group of troop instructions.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Ritual Valley stage where the BOT commander did not give attack instructions to the siege tower route.
[*] Fixed a squad mission for invading an enemy castle not being accomplished when invading the castle of a team that was destroyed in a 5-team battle.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed a unit to get a score for completing a unit mission after turning over when the unit was an attacking unit in a 5-team battle.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the fort section was not shown on the map of Ritual Valley A.
[*] Fixed a bug with the “Wave Blaster” skill that was sometimes causing it to incorrectly apply burning damage.
[*] Fixed a bug with the “Tower Rock” Arcane Art that sometimes prevented it from correctly appearing on the Map and Mini Map.
[*] Fixed a bug that could sometimes prevent other players from piloting a Robot if the original pilot was disconnected from the game.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/fe3a303b8a353d772d482559f9a07d6f28a3d402.png[/img]
[h2]<New Features>[/h2]
[list]
[*] Season 6 means a new Season Pass!
[list][*] Starting this season, there will be some changes to the Season Pass.
[list][*] The level limit has been changed from 100 to 50.
[list][*] The obtainable content and amount of experience required per level have been adjusted accordingly.[/list][*] The Season Pass and Premium Pass have been removed so that only the Free Pass is available.[/list][*] Obtain Goldings and other items in the upcoming login campaign![/list]
[*] New ★5 Cleric Title “Artificer” and Ult Skill “Turret Wall.”
[list][*] The Title Artificer provides a +100% building speed effect. 
[*] The “Turret Wall” Ult Skill summons a huge wall equipped with a machine gun turret to intercept enemies attempting to infiltrate your defensive structures.
[list][*] The turret automatically attacks enemies within a certain range.[/list][/list]
[*] New Arcane Art: “Judgment Strike!”
[list][*] Idols for Judgement Strike will now appear during Battle.
[*] Judgment Strike is an Arcane Art that calls forth a giant statue of a face in the sky above a designated spot to shoot a powerful beam down on the Battlefield. 
[list][*] Select the summon point from the full map.[/list][/list]
[*] Planned for Tuesday, Sep 3, 9:00 am UTC
[/list]
[h2]<Improvements & Changes>[/h2]
[list]
[*] The time required to capture a Tower has been adjusted to avoid situations where the status of Battle changes too frequently to keep track of.
[*] From Enemy Occupied to Neutral:
[list][*] Before adjustments 
[list][*] 1 player...16s 
[*] 2 players...8s  
[*] 3 players...5.33s 
[*] 4 players...4s 
[*] And so on, for up to 20 players.[/list][/list]
[list][*] After adjustment:  
[list][*] 1 player...30s 
[*] 2 players...15s 
[*] 3 players...7.5s 
[*] 4 players or more...5s[/list][/list]
[*] From neutral state to 100% captured: 
[list][*] Before adjustment: 
[list][*] 1 player...8s 
[*] 2 players...4s 
[*] 3 players...2.67s 
[*] 4 players...2s 
[*] And so on, for up to 20 players.[/list][/list]
[list][*] After adjustment:   
[list][*] 1 player...30s 
[*] 2 players...15s 
[*] 3 players...7.5s 
[*] 4 players or more...5s [/list][/list]
[*] In accordance with the above, changes were made to the behavior of Towers.
[list][*] The Capture Gauge no longer decreases automatically when at 80% to 100%. 
[*] You may Warp to allied Towers that are 80% Captured or more.[/list]
[*] Changed the top menu background.  
[list][*] The new background will be tailored to the upcoming mode preview.[/list]
[*] Added invincibility time when resurrecting after death in the lobby. 
[*] Improved the UI when purchasing items in the store to allow the user to specify the number of items to be purchased. 
[*] The white arrow UI that appears on the map when respawning has been removed to avoid confusion with the pin UI. 
[*] Changed the UI for campaigns and other campaigns on the tabs of the top menu to an icon type UI. 
[*] Other minor changes and improvements.
[/list]


[h2]<Bug Fixes>[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which characters that did not exist in your deck were sometimes set when you proceeded to the lobby with two or more decks. 
[*] Fixed a bug in which button prompt such as Display Gamer Card was sometimes not displayed in the Squad Rankings on the Result screen. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the leftmost Deploy Point cost in the deck to be 0 when entering a Battle after the countdown to the start of the Battle due to slow loading, etc. 
[*] Fixed the screen display text content when activating Arcane Arts and Cataclysms. 
[*] Fixed a problem in which the effect and contact icons for the Cleric skill “Energy Bless” were sometimes not displayed in the correct position. 
[*] Fixed a problem in which returning to the top menu screen with the microphone muted during a Battle would not allow the microphone to be unmuted in the top menu. 
[*] Fixed a problem in which the “Enhance” button prompt would not appear in certain positions when moving around the battering ram or siege tower in close proximity to it. 
[*] Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.23.0.1934, v1.23.0.1946 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h2]<New Features>[/h2]
[list]
[*]New bundles and cosmetics will be added to the store.

[*]New Cleric skill: "Energy Breath"[list]
[*]Planned for Jul 23 (Tue) 9:00 am UTC[/list][/list]
[h2]<Improvements & Changes>[/h2]
[list]
[*]Matching lobby has been overhauled.[list]
[*]Now players can meet up with other Warlanders in the lobby while waiting for Battles to begin![/list]
[*]Renovated the matchmaking lobby map to better accommodate a large group of players.[list]
[*]The standby lobby for 5-Army Battles and Custom Battles will still use the current lobby.
[*]The top menu and quest details menu have been revised to make it easier to check beginner, daily, and weekly quests.[/list]
[*]Beginner quests and daily/weekly quests can now progress simultaneously.

[*]The "Restore Defaults" setting in Options has been changed so that it is reflected separately for each tab.

[*]When new players are matched for their first Battle after completing the tutorial, tabs other than the top one will no longer be open.[list]
[*]The Deck/Character tab will be open only if you are unable to proceed to matchmaking due to CP cost overruns, etc.[/list]
[*]Now, when a new character is created, one Title each from rank 1~5 is obtained.

[*]In accordance with the change of publisher, the license description and links in the game have been changed and deleted where appropriate.

[*]The following languages are no longer supported in the game:[list]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Turkish
[*]Italian
[*]Polish
[*]Korean[/list]
[*]PROS has been removed. In-game rewards for PROS already earned will be retained.

[*]The heal effect of Divine Hammer has been modified so that it is applied immediately after reviving a character.

[*]Changed so that when a player holding Arcane Artes or a Cataclysm leaves the game, an Idol will appear in that player’s place.

[*]A connected gamepad no longer automatically becomes the main controller when that gamepads control stick is moved while the mouse is in use.[list]
[*]Now you need to press a button to switch.[/list]
[*]The maximum number of equipment slots available for purchase has been changed from 4 to 9.

[*]The inventory limit has been increased from 700 to 950 items.

[*]The prices of items sold in the Cosmetics tab of the Shop have been increased from 20 to 230 Goldings.

[*]The sale of some Glamours have been suspended.[/list]
[h2]<Bug Fixes>[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem in which changes made to avatar parts were discarded when returning to customization after purchasing an item for an avatar part that had not yet been unlocked after the avatar part had been changed.

[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the user to fall through the ground during the tutorial.

[*]Fixed bug where Mine Familiars could react to characters from allied armies in 5-Army Battles.

[*]Fixed bug where Thundershock could be adsorbed by a character on an allied army in a 5-Army Battle.

[*]Fixed bug where bots would sometimes try to recapture a Tower affected by Tower Lock.

[*]Fixed bug where the "Get in" prompt could appear when carrying battering rams or siege towers.

[*]Fixed a problem in which the "Party Participation Settings" in the Friend List were not saved after restarting the system.

[*]Fixed bug in which display mode did not switch when set to window mode if the resolution setting was 1280x720 (16:9) in full screen mode.

[*]Fixed bug where Mine Familiar explosions sometimes hit twice depending on hardware.

[*]Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[h1]<Union War III begins!>[/h1]
Union War III will be held from 9:00 am Friday, July 12 – 9:00 am Monday, July 29 UTC!

[h2]Times[/h2]
03:00 am / 05:00 am / 12:00 pm / 02:00 pm / 07:00 pm / 09:00 pm UTC (6 times per day)

Union War is a mode where players with the same Union Tag are more likely to be matched on the same Army. Players compete for rankings based on points earned from Battles.

Unions can be created and joined from the “Union” tab on the top page.
Union Tags can be set by entering text.
Exclusive stamp rewards for members of the top-ranked Unions.
Earn rewards such as stamps and Aura Crystals, based on your success within your Union.
Rewards can only be earned by completing at least 10 Battles as a member of that Union.

[h1]<Feature improvements and changes related to Union War>[/h1]
[list]
[*] Goldings have been added to member ranking rewards. 
[*] Member ranking rewards are now only earned by finishing in the top 30 in your Union Ranking.
[*] Points are now earned based on ranking in 5-Army Battles. 
[*] If a player is unable to participate in a Union War Battle due to reasons other than his/her own actions, he/she will receive a make-up bonus for the next Union War Battle. 
[*] Players who have not joined a Union will receive a message encouraging them to join one. 
[/list]

notes.title: 🌟 Notice of Change in Publisher 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h1]<Notice of Change in Publisher>[/h1]

As of Monday, July 1, 2024, the publisher of "Warlander" will be changed from PLAION to Toylogic Inc.
Until now, we here at Toylogic have been acting solely as the developers and post launch managers of Warlander. From now on, we will also act as publisher.

Our mission remains the same: we will continue to strive to make Warlander an ever more enjoyable experience for our users.

Accounts, play data, in-game currency, etc. will not be affected by the change of publisher.

[h2]Change to languages supported in game:[/h2]
Due to the change of publisher, the following languages will no longer be supported in game. 
[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Turkish
[*] Italian
[*] Polish
[*] Korean
[/list][h2]Inquiries[/h2]
Toylogic will also be the point of contact for all inquiries from users.
[h2][url=https://warlander.net/]https://warlander.net/[/url][/h2]
The contact point for inquiries and some procedures will be changed.

[h2]Community management[/h2]
Toylogic will also provide community support for social media accounts, Discord, etc., including for communities outside of Japan.
Some support details and systems will be changed.

[h2]Other Notes[/h2]
Company names, contact information, etc. listed in each platform store, game, official website, etc. will be updated as necessary.
Please be aware that some things may take longer to reflect these changes than others.

Thank you for your continued support of Warlander.

[h1]<FAQ>[/h1]
[h2]MTX[/h2]
[h3]Q: What happens to my free and paid in-game currency?[/h3]
A: All in-game currency will continue to be available. There will be no change in the currency you hold.

[h2]PROGRESS[/h2]
[h3]Q: What happens to any progress in the game such as character development, equipment, rewards, points and position on the leaderboard?[/h3]
A: You will keep all of your progress. There will be no changes.

[h2]SERVER/MATCHMAKING[/h2]
[h3]Q: Will the accessibility of the game servers change? Are there plans to change the number of servers or the geographical location of the servers? Will this have an impact on matchmaking in terms of waiting time?[/h3]
A: There will be no changes. However, this may change in the future as we develop and manage Warlander.

[h2]SEASONS[/h2]
[h3]Q: Will there still be seasons with new game content? What changes will there be here? Or will there be new seasons with the usual content at the usual intervals? (Could be answered with the next question, but should be emphasized as this is the main motivation to continue playing)[/h3]
A: There will be no changes.  We plan to continue to operate seasons in the same cycle as before. However, this may change in the future as we develop and manage Warlander.

[h2]PLATFORMS[/h2]
[h3]Q: Are there plans to change the number of platforms? Will the cross-platform functionality such as the friends list continue to be available without restrictions?[/h3]
A: There will be no changes. Warlander will continue to be available on the platforms it is currently available on.

[h2]PROS[/h2]
[h3]Q: What are the consequences if PROS is removed from the game as part of the handover? Will I lose the PROS rewards I have already received? Will I no longer be able to access Warlander via the PROS website? What will happen to my PROS email address that I registered for Warlander, or the one I had before Warlander but linked to the game?[/h3]
A: Warlander will be removed from your PROS account. You will keep your PROS rewards. If you only used PROS for Warlander, you can request an account deletion in the PROS settings.

[h2]SUPPORT[/h2]
[h3]Q: What impact will this have on game support? Who can we contact if we have questions about the game or problems with the game? Will response times change?[/h3]
A: Toylogic will take charge of the game support. Response times might change.

[h2]COMMUNITY[/h2]
[h3]Q: How does this affect community management? What happens to our close contacts? Who can we contact as before? What happens to feature upvote and bug fixing as well as balancing feedback?[/h3]
A: Community Management both in and outside of Japan will be taken over by Toylogic. Some aspects of how support is handled may change.
We’re looking into a solution to keep Feature Upvote going.

[h2]WEBSITE/CHANNELS[/h2]
[h3]Q: Will the website address remain the same? Can information about the game still be obtained via this page and the previous channels? What will change here?[/h3]
A: The official website will be renewed. Social media accounts will remain the same.
[url=https://warlander.net/]https://warlander.net/[/url]

[h2]GDPR[/h2]
[h3]Q: Who will be our contact person for data protection in the future? Who will take responsibility for data protection?[/h3]
A: Toyologic will be responsible for data protection.
For more information on data protection, please refer to our Privacy Policy which will be posted on our renewed official website.

[h2]PREVIOUS PLAN[/h2]
[h3]Q: What happens to the previous, communicated plan regarding bugfixing, features, events and so on?[/h3]
A: There will be no changes. We will continue to manage and develop the game.

[h2]CONTENT PARTNER PROGRAM[/h2]
[h3]Q: What will happen with the Content Partner Program?[/h3]
A: The Content Partner Program will be disbanded and no longer supported.

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.12.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h1]<New Features>[/h1]
[list]
[*] New bundles and cosmetics will be added to the Shop.
[*] New time limited event: “Mad Tea Party”
[list]
[*] Event period: June 25 (Tue.) 9:00 am - July 9 (Tue.) 9:00 am UTC
[*] Event Shop period: June 25 (Tue.) 9:00 am- July 12 (Fri) 9:00 am UTC
[*] During the event, you can exchange items collected during special battles for limited edition items in the Event Shop.
[/list][*] New Mage skill “Dragon Breath”
[list]
[*] This skill allows Mages to spew flames to attack enemies or set objects on fire
[/list][*] Union War III is coming!
[list]
[*] Event period: July 12 (Fri) 9:00 am - July 29 (Mon.) 9:00 am UTC
[/list][/list]

[h1]<Improvements & Changes>[/h1]
[list]
[*] Feature improvements and changes related to Union War.
[list]
[*] Goldings have been added to member ranking rewards.
[*] Member ranking rewards are now only earned by finishing in the top 30 in your Union Ranking.
[*] The number of points earned have been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Points are now earned based on ranking in 5-Army Battles.
[*] If a player is unable to participate in a Union War Battle due to reasons other than his/her own actions, he/she will receive a make-up bonus for the next Union War Battle.
[/list][*] Added notification for when matchmaking cannot be done.
[*] Players who have not joined a Union will receive a message encouraging them to join one.
[/list][*] To make it easier to distinguish between friend and foe, the transparency of visual effects and sound effects have been adjusted for some skills.
[list]
[*] Includes Windblast, Waveblaster, Phoenix, Ignition, Firewall, Snow Vortex, Ice Missile, Cursed Sword
[/list][*] Improved the tutorial to make it easier to understand.
[*] Added banners and voices when Arcane Arts are activated.
[*] Added the ability for bots to be equipped with Glamours.
[*] Changed Loadout UI in the Shop.
[list]
[*] Increased the number of products displayed in the Loadout section of the Shop.
[*] Can now select different rarities of the same piece of equipment on the same screen.
[/list][*] Changed the post-match win-loss camera sequence to be more concise.
[*] Changed the number of votes a Commander can have to 2 when selecting a role.
[*] Simplified the voting process when selecting a role and adjusted the UI accordingly.
[*] Hair color thumbnails are now displayed in multiple colors if that hair color contains multiple colors.
[*] Added sound effects when transitioning from the matchmaking lobby to a Battle.
[*] Improved sound effects when firing and when a shot hits to make them easier to understand.
[*] Other minor improvements and changes.
[/list]

[h1]<Bug Fixes> [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed a Tower to be captured while the Tower capture gauge was still not full, ignoring enemy players in range.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the Tower capture gauge would sometimes not be maintained when an enemy approached while the Tower was captured but still in contention.
[*] Fixed an issue where class icons were not being reflected correctly in the armor color change screen.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

notes.title: 🌟 Union War II begins! 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f8dbcb1f0e44b2878220004783c3685d264c7a4c.png[/img]

[h1]<Union War II begins!>[/h1]
Union War II will be held from 9:00 am Tuesday, June 4 – 9:00 am Friday, June 21 UTC!

[b]Times[/b]
03:00 am / 05:00 am / 12:00 pm / 02:00 pm / 07:00 pm / 09:00 pm UTC (6 times per day)

Union War is a mode where players with the same Union Tag are more likely to be matched on the same Army. Players compete for rankings based on points earned from Battles.

Unions can be created and joined from the “Union” tab on the top page. Union Tags can be set by entering text. Exclusive stamp rewards for members of the top-ranked Unions.

Earn rewards such as stamps and Aura Crystals, based on your success within your Union. Rewards can only be earned by completing at least 10 Battles as a member of that Union.

[h2]Changes from Union War I[/h2]
Starting with this War, 5-Army Battles will also be available in Union War during certain hours on Friday, Saturdays and Sundays!

In addition, the influence of top members in each Union-on-union ranking will be adjusted so that even Unions with fewer participants can earn more points.

1st - 5th: x10
6th - 10th: x5
11th - 30th: x3
31st - 100th: x1 
101st and beyond: x0.1

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.12.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h2]<New Features>[/h2]
[list]
  [*]New Season Pass available at the start of Season 5!
  [list]
    [*]Raise your season level and earn exclusive items!
    [*]Plus, a login campaign for Goldings and other items is coming soon!
  [/list]
  [*]Union War II Begins!
  [list]
    [*]Starting with this War, 5- Army Battles will also be available in Union War during certain hours on Saturdays and Sundays!
    [*]In addition, the influence of top members in each Union on union ranking will be adjusted so that even Unions with fewer participants can earn more points.
    [list]
      [*]1st – 5th: x10
      [*]6th – 10th: x5
      [*]11th – 30th: x3
      [*]31st – 100th: x1 
      [*]101st and beyond: x0.1
    [/list][*]The duration of the event will be changed to the following dates.
    [list]
      [*]June 04 at 12:00 am -  June 21 at 12:00 am UTC
    [/list][*]We will continue to make improvements to Union War and implement additional features.
  [/list]
  [*]New 5★ Warrior Title Typhon and Ult Skill Behemoth Shield!
  [list][*]Take to the vanguard and brandish the unbreakable power of the Behemoth to repel enemies and projectiles alike!
    [*]The durability of the Behemoth Shield decreases over time or when object damage is inflicted upon it. Once durability reaches 0, it disappears.
  [/list]
  [*]New Armor types for each class!
  [list]
    [*]Featuring a new motif inspired by modern warfare!
  [/list]
  [*]Implemented additional replica parts for CP0 to make it easier to enjoy cosmetics.[list]
  [*]All players will receive additional replica parts for all armor types.
  [*]If your inventory is full, you will not receive these items until you have freed up space by selling items. You can reload the game once you have freed up inventory space to receive the items.
  [*]Chinese added to Battle Banner voice options.[/list][/list]
[h2]<Improvements>[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Removed Squad Role announcement in all modes to shorten the strategy phase.
  [*]Changed so that players eligible for beginner matchmaking cannot select Solo Mode.
  [*]There will now be a different scene depending on what Rank the Title you receive is.
  [*]For Union War, the Stats display is changed from win percentage to number of wins as 2- army and 5- army battles will both affect score.
  [*]A new icon will now display when a new avatar part is obtained.
  [*]Color Powder can now be obtained from the product detail screen. 
  [*]To make the item list easier to read, only specific colors will be displayed in the list for unowned Glamours.
  [*]Available Glamours appear at the top of the Change Glamour screen.
  [*]All gates, battering rams, and siege towers are now shown even when the minimap is expanded to full view.
  [*]Idols, Siege Towers, and Battering Rams of armies whose Cores have been destroyed in a 5- army battle will disappear.
  [*]Can now use Stay/Help Up/Resurrect in the middle of the target’s death animation.
  [*]Improved behavior while jumping to improve play feel.[list][*]This does not change the jump distance.
  [/list]  [*]Valor points will no longer be earned for damaging wooden objects other than gates, gate frames, and anti- siege weapon foundations.
[/list]
[list]
  [*]Warrior Skill Barrier
  [list]
    [*]Rather than working exclusively on a timer, Barrier will now have a durability value that decreases over time and when taking damage. The Skill will fade once durability reaches 0.
    [list]
      [*]Examples of how to damage it include Guard Break, Smash, Rushdown, Charge Attack, Somersault, Wind Mine.
    [/list]    [*]CP:10/20/30/40/50 ⇒ /20/40/60/80/100
    [*]Durability: 400/480/560/640/720
    [*]Durability decrease per second:40
  [/list][/list][list]
  [*]Warrior Skill Guard Shot
  [list]
    [*]Aim assist now applied when using controller.
  [/list][/list][list][*]Warrior Ult Skill Colossus Form
  [list]
    [*]Hitstun and status effects will now be prevented or reduced, drawing more attention from the enemy camp and making it easier to withstand enemy attacks. In exchange, movement speed in colossus form will be reduced to mitigate this skill’s ability to breakthrough enemy defenses.
    [*]Colossus Form can now be activated even when on fire or frozen.
    [*]In Colossus form, removes on fire and frozen status effects and prevents both from occurring.
    [*]Firewall, Snow Vortex, and Thundershock no longer cause a slowdown.
    [*]When using Barrier in Colossus Form, in addition to the durability change, the size is adjusted from 4.5 to 3.5.
    [*]Movement speed increase: 1.36 ⇒ 1.2
  [/list][/list][list]
  [*] Mage Ult Skill Thunderstorm
  [list]
    [*]Lightning strikes generated by Thunderstorm are now aimed at any enemies within range.
  [/list][/list][list]
  [*]Mage Familiars
  [list]
    [*]Familiars can now be summoned while aiming down sights.
  [/list][/list][list]
  [*]Mage’s Gyroscope 
  [list]
    [*]To improve usability, it will continue to shoot automatically any time the summoner would be able to shoot.  [/list]
[/list]
[h2]<Bug Fixes>[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Fixed a bug that prevented 2 instances of the Mage Skill Fog from two "Fog" from being active at the same time.
  [*]Fixed an issue where debris would not fly away when the Cleric Skill "Wall" was destroyed.
  [*]Fixed incorrect description of object damage on the "Thundershock” magic shot tooltip.
  [*]Fixed issue where Cleric Skill "Somersault" would sometimes have a shorter blast away distance.
  [*]Fixed issue where Mage Skill "Wind Blast" would sometimes not do damage when hitting the metal part in front of the catapult.
  [*]Fixed bug where the effect of a certain attack power up perk was not reflected in the Item Details Screen.[list]
    [*]Sword Attack Power Up / Hammer Attack Power Up / Bowgun Attack Power Up / Magic Shot Attack Power Up
[/list]  [*]Fixed a bug in which characters were sometimes not displayed on the "Requirements Completed" screen when Prestige conditions were met.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which the icon of the "Sphere Shield" was different when purchased from the Shop.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which players were not damaged when caught in a robot explosion.
  [*]Fixed a bug in the Union list where key help and platform icons were not displayed for BOTs that were replaced after a player left a Battle.
  [*]Fixed a bug in the Union list that allowed players to send a report in an empty space when sorting.
  [*]Fixed a bug in the scoreboard that when a player "reported" a BOT that had left a Battle and been replaced, the BOT name was displayed in the dialog instead of the original player's name.
  [*]Fixed a bug where the "Basic Operation HUD" would remain visible even if the "Show Tutorial" option was turned off.
  [*]Fixed an issue where players could request to follow a player who was already following them on the scoreboard.
  [*]Fixed an issue where Familiar Cooldown would not stop while the Mage was dead.
  [*]Fixed an issue where the color of a Beam Saber would change when using the Warrior Skill "Will of Steel" while the Glamour "Beam Saber" was equipped
  [*]Fixed an issue where changing the color of the Glamour "Sage's Incense Burner" was not reflected in the color icon.
  [*]Fixed an issue where the sub- color of the Glamour "Black Turtle Shield" was not reflected in the color selected by color change.
  [*]Fixed a bug in 5- Army Battles where the Robot did not disappear when the Core of the army with the Robot's color was destroyed while being summoned through a Cataclysm.
  [*]Fixed a bug in 5- Army Battles where BOTs would sometimes not follow the Commander's instructions.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which, at the start of a Battle, when the Commander gave a Squad instructions, there were Squads with Squad numbers higher than 6.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which hit sound effects and visual effects were displayed when attacking the Core of your own army.
  [*]Fixed a bug where the icon of the Robot’s Cataclysm Idol was not displayed on the mini- map during Battle.
  [*]Fixed a bug where Thundershock's object damage was not listed in the item description tooltip.
  [*]Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash after exiting the "Support" menu.
  [*]Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.19.1.1 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Cleric skill Sphere Shield now available!
[list][*] This skill allows you to set a dome-shaped shield on the battlefield to block long-range enemy attacks. Create safety on a fierce battlefield to support your allies!
[*] The Sphere Shield only protects against long-range attacks, and it is damaged by attacks that damage objects.
[*] It will disappear after a set amount of time or when its durability reaches 0.
[*] The higher the skill’s level, the higher the durability of the Sphere Shield it creates.[/list]
[*] Adjusted the parameters of various Skills.
[list][*] In addition to the skills that were adjusted this time, we are testing CP and performance adjustments for several other skills. We plan to apply these adjustments as they become available.
[*] Cleric Skill Heal
[list][*] CP will be adjusted to improve convenience in customization and fairness among classes. The skill recovered too much HP at skill level 1, and the support performance of low-Rank Clerics was higher than expected.
[*] CP:15/30/60/90/100⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] CT:15⇒18
[*] Amount of HP healed:100/115/145/175/185⇒75/100/125/150/175[/list]
[*] Cleric Skill Area Heal
[list][*] CP will be adjusted to improve convenience in customization and fairness among classes. Skill duration will be lowered because the length of the skill made the durability of Clerics too high. While the amount of HP restored by the skill will be reduced, the range of the effect will be increased improving its value as a ranged support skill. These changes will also take into account the changed CP.
[*] CP:20/35/75/110/125⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] Amount of HP healed:13/14.4/18.3/21.7/23.2⇒10/11.8/13.6/15.4/17.2
[*] Effect radius:5/5.6/7.2/8.6/9.2⇒7/7.8/8.6/9.4/10.2
[*] Duration:30⇒12[/list]
[*] Mage Skill Flash Step
[list][*] To improve the usability as an evasion skill, it will be adjusted so that it starts moving as soon as it is activated.[/list]
[*] Mage Skill Rocket Punch
[list][*] In order to better clarify the Mage’s role of destroying objects, we are adjusting the damage to objects.
[*] Object damage:150/172.5/195/217.5/240⇒250/287.5/325/362.5/400[/list]
[*] Mage Skill Wave Blaster
[list][*] CP will be adjusted to improve convenience in customization and fairness among classes. Both damage dealt and bullet size will be adjusted, making it easier to hit opponents while maintaining balance with CP cost.
[*] CP:20/50/90/105/110⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] Enemy damage:80/92/108/114/118⇒80/88/96/104/112
[*] Object damage:40/46/54/57/59⇒40/44/48/52/56
[*] Bullet size:2/2.46/2.56/2.59/2.62⇒2.25/2.35/2.45/2.55/2.65[/list]
[*] Mage Base HP
[list][*] The low base HP of the Mage resulted in a lower-than-expected survivability. Therefore, we are increasing the Mage’s base HP.
[*] Base HP: 100→150[/list]
[*] Perk Adjustments
[list][*] Adjusted HP recovery perks to balance out the reduction to HP healed by Cleric Skills.
[*] Nightstalker Tenacity: HP Healed 75⇒50
[*] Duelist's Tenacity: HP Healed 100⇒75
[*] Vanguard's Tenacity: HP Healed 50⇒35
[*] Summoner's Tenacity: HP Healed 55⇒40[/list][/list][/list]

notes.title: 🌟 Arcane Arts: Tower Lock and Warlander Update Announcement! 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[h2]Arcane Arts: Tower Lock is now available![/h2]
From 9:00 am Tuesday, April 23, a new gameplay system is coming to Warlander: Arcane Arts!

As with Cataclysms, Arcane Arts are obtained by touching Idols that appear on the battlefield. Arcane Idols appear on the battlefield from the start of the Battle, and the Arts themselves are specialized for near combat.

The new Arcane Art Tower Lock forces a Tower to remain under control by the user's Army for a certain period of time making it impossible to Capture!

[h2]Warlander Update Announcement[/h2]
The following changes were made Thursday, 9:00 am April 18 UTC.

Starting this weekend, the frequency of 5-Army Battles will change from every 30 minutes to every 60 minutes.

*The frequency may change again without prior notice.

*We will also switch to a reservation matchmaking system during certain time slots *Time slots may change without notice.

During the time slots covered by the matchmaking reservation system, a check box will appear on the top menu asking if you wish to make a reservation. 

By checking the box, matchmaking will start automatically when it is time to make a reservation.

*You will need to wait at the top menu.

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.18.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a dialog box on the cosmetics Shop screen explaining the conditions under which the product can be previewed if there is no applicable character available.
[*] Added "Check Color Variations," "Toggle Full Body/Single Item Display," and "Switch Army" functions to the Season Pass reward detail screen.
[*] Can now display where Cataclysms were activated on the map.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Thundershock can now attack Cataclysmic Idols.
[*] Dispel can now be used against Wall.
[*] When a player is disconnected from a Battle and replaced with a BOT, the BOT will now spawn in the castle instead of where the player disconnected. 
[*] Button to select Deck changed to Enter for keyboard, X for Xbox, Square for PS5
[*] When select a Deck, the cursor will now start on that Deck the next time you go to select a Deck. 
[*] Changed some items in the battle banner to show the names of the players involved.
[*] Changed the default state of the mini-map to show the whole map.
[*] Adjustments made to Skills for each class.
[*] To encourage Skill customization, Skills with extremely high or low CP will be adjusted. We will also utilize development data such as usage rates in each rank range when making adjustments. The Lunge Slash, Rushdown, and Rocket Attack skills will have their armor removed, as the resistance against hitstun provided by these moves takes away the role of other Skills that repel or help evade nearby enemies, and significantly undermines the three prongs of melee combat (attack beats guard break beats guard beats attack). Skills that were not adjusted this time are currently being examined and will be adjusted as needed.
[list]

[*] Warrior Skill “Roll”
[list]
[*] Roll was originally envisioned as a high-level skill with three prominent uses: attack, evade, and move. We will adjust the damage and Cooldown time of this rolling attack to better establish it as an evasion skill.
[*] CP:10/20/30/40/50⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] Cooldown (s):16/14/12/10/8⇒18/16/14/12/10
[*] Damage to enemies: 80⇒50
[*] Damage to objects: 80⇒50
[/list]
[*] Warrior Skill “Lunge Slash”
[list]
[*] This Skill’s level-based range scaling will be swapped out for better damage to make it more of a damage skill for use in close-quarters combat in order to differentiate it from Rocket Attack. Also, removed the armor that is present on activation, as it was muddling the overall melee combat strategy.
[*] Removed super armor on activation
[*] CP:15/30/60/90/100⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] Attack distance (m):12/12.9/14.7/16.5/17.1⇒10
[*] Damage: 40/41.5/44.5/47.5/48.5⇒60/66/72/78/84
[/list]
[*] Warrior Skill “Rushdown”
[list]
[*] As there was not much value to be found in increasing the skill level for this Skill, we have changed it so that the Cooldown now scales with skill level. Also, removed the armor that is present on activation, as it was muddling the overall melee combat strategy.
[*] Removed super armor on activation
[*] CP:20/35/75/110/125⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] Cooldown (s):13⇒20/18/16/14/12
[*] Damage:30/32.25/38.25/43.5/45.75⇒30/31.5/33/34.5/36
[/list]
[*] Warrior Skill “Rocket Attack”
[list]
[*] To better emphasize this Skills ability to strike a target behind enemy lines, the Cooldown, travel distance, and damage will now scale with skill level. In exchange, the base damage of this Skill is now lower. Also, removed the armor that is present on activation, as it was muddling the overall melee combat strategy.
[*] Removed super armor on activation
[*] CP:30/45/90/130/150⇒20/40/60/80/100
[*] Cooldown (s): 15⇒17/16/15/14/13
[*] Attack distance (m): 16/16.54/18.16/19.6/20.32⇒14/16/18/20/22
[*] Damage: 100/103.75/115/125/130⇒60/63/66/69/72
[/list]
[*] Warrior Skill “Will of Steel”
[list]
[*] Since there were few ways to deal with it, it can now be removed with the Cleric’s Dispel Skill.

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Game Update v1.17.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[h2]New Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] Spring Easter Festival  
[list][*] Collect Dyed Eggs in Battle and exchange them for limited-time items. 
[*] Event duration is Mar 19 9:00 - Apr 2 9:00 UTC 
[*] The Event Shop will be open until Apr 5, 9:00 UTC. [/list]
[*] New products added to Bundle Cosmetics on the Shop screen. 
[*] Added the ability to change the color of equipment. [list]
[*] This function changes the color of equipment to a predetermined color. 
[*] The color of equipment can be changed by using color change items (color powder). 
[*] Color powder can be purchased from the "More" tab in the store. [/list]
[*] Preview Feature added to Shop. 
[list][*] Players can have their characters try on equipment in the Shop before purchasing it. [/list]
[*] Added the ability to switch between a single item and full-body display in the Shop. 
[*] Added option to toggle other players’ visual and sound effect items ON/OFF. 
[*] Revamped tutorial mode. 
[list][*] Practical Tutorials will be removed from Game Mode Select. 
[/list][/list]

[h2]Feature Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 24 Skills (8 each for the 3 classes) from release are now available to all players. 
[list][*] This will enable players who have just started Warlander to immediately experiment with and enjoy character customization. 
[*] In line with this change, some rewards for beginner quests will be changed. [/list]
[*] Mythic weapons have been added to the "Loadout" Shop lineup, allowing them to be purchased with Silvings. 
[*] Added a feature that makes it easier to see allies' HP when playing as Cleric. 
[list][*] This makes it easier to see the HP of allies whose HP is decreasing and increases the range and number of allies displayed. 
[*] You can turn this feature on and off in the options screen. [/list]
[*] Now displays the name of the character that is equipping or previewing equipment on the equipment details screen. 
[*] "Deploy cooldown" has been changed to "Deploy Cost" on the character edit screen and character slot screen. 
[*] The following adjustments have been made to Cataclysmic Idols. 
[list][*] Fixed a bug that could cause Idols to appear in locations where there were no players on the target army. 
[*] Will now appear near the castle when there is no other location for it to appear. [/list]
[*] The Mage Skill "Shadow Step" now displays a trajectory effect in the direction it travels. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where if a player killed by an explosion touches another player during their death animation, the touched player gets hurt too. 
[*] Fixed a bug in Dawn Bridge A/B where the castle winch could be opened from the outside. 
[*] Fixed a bug that rarely caused a falling death when boarding a Battering Ram at Dawn Bridge B. 
[*] Fixed issue where Rocket Punches to the lower part of a siege tower could deal damage twice. 
[*] Fixed an issue in which the ammunition restoration rate for ranged weapons remained the same while aiming when switching from aim view to normal view. 
[*] When a player exits a match in Arena mode and switches to a Bot, the bot will now spawn at the starting position. 
[*] Fixed a bug in the HDR brightness adjustment screen where the adjustment screen itself would unintentionally brighten/darken depending on the brightness setting value. 
[*] Other minor bug fixes. 
[/list]

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Update 1.16 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[b][*] Season 4 will begin on February 20, 2024[/b]
[list]
[*] A new Season Pass will be added, and the Shop lineup will be redesigned.
[/list][*] New ★5 title Frostbane and new Ultskill Ice Minigun for Mages.
[list]
[*] The caster unleashes a relentless volley of ice bullets to suppress enemies with overwhelming firepower.
[/list][*] The Deploy Point System will now be the official System for Deploying Characters in Warlander.
[list]
[*] Deploy Points are obtained over time, when a certain number of Valor points are earned, or when the core of your army is attacked. Under this system, players will use those points to launch a character with a high Title Rank.
[*] Changes since the last Deploy Point system preview:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the amount of Deploy Points required for Characters of each Title Rank.
[list]
[*] V1: 50
[*] V2: 150 → 100
[*] V3: 300 → 200
[*] V4: 600 → 400
[*] V5: 1200 → 1500
[/list][*] Adjusted the number of the Deploy Point bonus from earning Valor points.
[list]
[*] 1000 VP: 10 → 20 Deploy Points
[*] 2000 VP: 20 → 40 Deploy Points
[*] 3000 VP: 30 → 60 Deploy Points
[*] 4000 VP: 40 → 80 Deploy Points
[*] 5000 VP: 50 → 100 Deploy Points
[*] Every additional 1000 VP after 5000: 60→120 Deploy Points.
[/list][/list][*] With the introduction of the Deploy Point system, the previous system that raises the Valor Points earned when defeating an enemy of higher Title Rank will be removed.
[*] This was implemented at the time of the last Deploy Point system preview, but went unmentioned in official channels. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
[/list][*] Added episode 4 "The Warlords" to the Chronicle.
[*] Added the ability to purchase unpurchased Glamours and other items from the customization screen.
[*] Added feature to see what items are for sale in the Cosmetics tab when logging in.
[*] Added feature that displays an icon in the Shop tab when an update is made.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The maximum number of players who can achieve Aura Rank will be 100 starting this season.
[*] Improved Dawn Bridge B.
[list]
[*] Matching with Dawn Bridge A, the following actions were taken:
[list]
[*] Lanes were better separated from each other to emphasize the role of each lane.
[*] Doors were added to each lane to increase the amount of back and forth gameplay.
[/list][*] Adjustments were made near the center of the stage to allow for a different strategies than Dawn Bridge A by placing a stone bridge connecting the north and south lanes.
[*] Other adjustments have been made to the stage throughout.
[*] We will continue to make improvements to maps.
[/list][*] The strategy selection screen will be removed from 2-team battles.
[list]
[*] This is the screen where Offense, Defense, or Balanced strategy is selected through voting. It was removed in order to improve the tempo of the game and because Balance was selected in the majority of Battles.
[*] This will also reduce the waiting time on the role selection screen.
[/list][*] We have made improvements to Bots, reducing the number of times a Bot hits a seemingly distant Bot due to lag.
[*] Adjustments will be made to the Battle record information used for matchmaking and will now be based on a wider variety of factors.
[*] Shop: change so that unowned items are prioritized for sale within the first 3 pages of the Cosmetics tab and elsewhere.
[list]
[*] When you purchase an item within the first 3 pages, it will automatically be replaced by another item that you do not yet own.
[/list][*] The Squad Respawn system will be removed.
[list]
[*] We had hoped that Squad Respawn would encourage teamwork within Squads, but we decided to remove it because it obscured frontline tactics by affecting the number of players on the front line and allowed players who could communicate to make better use of their resources than other players.
[/list][*] The Stormbringer Ult Skill "Thunderstorm" now grants 10 protection per second to the caster when used.
[/list]

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Update 1.15.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Alternate Deploy Point System—Preview 2
[list]

[*] With this system, characters consume "Deploy points," which are different from traditional Valor points, when they Re-Deploy.
[*] The higher the Title Rank of a character, the more Deploy points required.
[*] This is a preview of this system which means we will collect data and feedback before finalizing the decision on whether we stay with this system or revert to the original system.
[*] Deploy Point acquisition has been improved since the last preview. Deploy Points can be increased in three ways:
[list]

[*] Over Time
[list]

[*] Obtain the following number of points at 10-second intervals:
[*] 0-180s: 10 points per 10s
[*] 181-360s: 20 points per 10s
[*] 361-540s: 30 points per 10s
[*] 541-720s: 40 points per 10s
[*] 721 to 900s: 50 points per 10s
[*] During Overtime: 60 points per 10s
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] When your Core is damaged
[list]

[*] 30 points for every 100 damage inflicted to your Core
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] Earn a certain amount of Valor Points (VP)
[list]

[*] 1000 VP earned: 10 points
[*] 2000 VP earned: 20 points
[*] 3000 VP earned: 30 points
[*] 4000 VP earned: 40 points
[*] 5000 VP earned: 50 points
[*] After that, 60 points for every additional 1000 VP earned.
[/list][/list][/list]
[list]
[*] The amount of Deploy Points required to produce each title rank is as follows.
[list]

[*] Title Rank 1: 50
[*] Title Rank 2: 150
[*] Title Rank 3: 300
[*] Title Rank 4: 600
[*] Title Rank 5: 1200
[/list][/list]
[*] Added a new basic action: Execute
[list]

[*] Can be used on a downed opponent by pressing and holding the F key/Square button/X button.
[*] A character that has been "Executed" cannot be revived without re-deploying and is penalized by having its Deploy Cost increased.
[list]

[*] A character with Title Rank 0 will not be penalized for being Executed.
[/list]
[*] The penalty will be removed once the Executed character is Deployed again.
[*] The increase in Deploy Cost depends on the character's Title Rank.
[*] Finishers for Warriors and Clerics will also have the same effect as Execute.
[list]

[*] Valor points earned during Finisher will be changed from 200 to 50.
[/list][/list]
[*] Improved Dawn Bridge A map
[list]

[*] We are now making improvements to Dawn Bridge A to solve two major problems:
[list]

[*] Doors that need to be destroyed are placed at the connecting passage between lanes.
[list]

[*] Currently, once a lane was breached, it was possible to move immediately to another lane. This obscured the role of each lane and made it difficult to push back because once one lane was invaded, all lanes could be penetrated.
[/list]
[*] 2. Additional gates must be broken through in all lanes
[list]

[*] Currently, there are few steps to push and pull in each lane, making it difficult to understand the front line and making the siege experience pale in comparison.
[/list][/list]
[*] Other adjustments have been made to the map throughout.
[*] We will continue to make improvements to this and other maps in the future.
[/list]
[*] New "Special Effects" added.
[list]

[*] You can set the effects that are displayed for your footsteps, upon death, and when warping.
[*] Can be set from the customization screen.
[*] Special Effects can be purchased in the store with Silvings.
[/list]
[*] Added anonymous display feature for content creators.
[list]
[*] All other player names can now be hidden with the exception of yourself and your party members.
[*] This can be set from the options screen.
[*] Only supported on Steam and PS5.
[/list]
[*] Added more tips for the loading screen.
[*] Add spectator feature to Custom Battles.
[list]

[*] Allows you to participate in Custom Battles as a spectator.
[/list]
[*] Added player account system PROS.
[list]

[*] Be the first to know what's new in Warlander by registering your email address.
[*] You can register an account from the support screen in game.
[*] Register an account to receive the following rewards.
[list]

[*] Warrior Epic Equipment x2
[*] Cleric Epic Equipment x2
[*] Mage Epic Equipment x2
[*] Character EXP Booster x5
[*] Reward Volume Booster x5
[/list][/list]
[*] New Chronicles added to Movies.
[list]

[*] EP3 The False World and The Trials
[/list]
[*] Add SE when using response voice macro
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]

[*] When re-deploying at the castle, you will be able to choose one of several locations.
[*] Valor Points can now be earned by destroying enemy Idols.
[*] The shape of the roof of the battering ram after enhancement has been adjusted to make it more difficult for bullets from the front to pass through.
[*] Adjustments will be made to the Cleric skill Resurrection.
[list]

[*] The CP and Cooldown (CD) have been decreased to make the skill easier to use, while the percentage of HP granted when reviving an ally has been decreased as the effect of reviving an ally with high HP has too great an impact on battle. The ability to revive from a distance also frequently made it difficult to understand who revived who, so the range will also be reduced.
[*] CP: 45/60/110/155/175⇒30/50/70/90/110
[*] CD: 120/90/49/34/30⇒30/28/26/24/22
[*] HP percentage at revival (%): 100⇒ Per Skill Level 20/30/40/50/60
[*] Range (m): 30⇒20
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which the cooldown for team skills only advanced upon death.
[*] Perk: Fixed a bug where the effect of Jump Attack Power UP was not expressed in %.
[*] Fixed a bug where the oil jar could not be activated immediately after grabbing it.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Update 1.13.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Game Mode: Union War! Separate into player groups called Unions and aim for the top of the leaderboards.
[list]
[*] First, this will be introduced in a preview event three times a day (4:00 am/2:00 pm/9:00 pm UTC) from Nov 28 to Dec 12.
[*] Each player sets a Union Tag. Players with matching Union Tags are considered to be in the same union.
[list]
[*] Players with the same Union Tag are more likely to be matched in the same Battle and on the same Army.
[*] During the preview event, you can only select from preset Unions.
[/list]
[*] Each player earns rank points from Battle results. The overall Union Ranking is determined by Union Points which are calculated from the rank points earned by each player belonging to the union.
[*] Union ranking is determined by the sum of all members' rank points, and each player's rank is multiplied by a multiplier (influence coefficient) according to his/her rank in the members' ranking.
[list]
[*] Members ranked 1~10 within their Union have their points tripled, while those ranked 101st and below have their points multiplied by 0.1. This means that even a union with a relatively small number of members may be able to compete with a union with a large number of members depending on the performance of its top members!
[/list][/list]
[*] The point system for Deploying Characters with high-ranking Titles will be changed.
[list]
[*] When a character respawns, this will cost Deploy Points.
[*] Deploy points increase over time; the later in the Battle, the more points obtained.
[*] Deploy points also increase when your Army’s Core is damaged. 
[*] A preview event for this mode will be held on the following dates (all times in UTC):
[list]
[*] 9:00 am November 28 to 8:59 am December 1
[*] 9:00 am December 2 to 8:59 am December 4
[/list]
[*] Major Change to Battle Rules
[list]
[*] The current system, which allows players to Deploy Characters with higher Title Ranks earlier by earning Valor Points, frequently resulted in the team that won the battle early on by Deploying Characters with high ranked Titles, causing the development of the game to become one-sided. Furthermore, the actions that lead to victory change depending on the situation, which makes it difficult to create a comprehensive evaluation system for earning Valor Points. This new system awards point over time, making it easier to formulate strategies for which character to Deploy at which point in time. We also hope that this system will make it easier for comebacks to occur by awarding points to Armies that have taken damage to their Cores.
[/list][/list]
[*] New Squad Respawn System
[list]
[*] You will now be able to Warp/respawn at a Squad Member's location to make it easier to act as part of a Squad.
[*] However, a Squad Warp or Squad respawn cannot occur under the following conditions:
[list]
[*] When the target Squad member is in an enemy keep
[*] When the target Squad member is near an enemy
[/list][/list]
[*] New Mage skill: Snow Vortex
[list]
[*] A violent whirlwind of snow that inflicts ice damage and freezes enemies in range.
[/list]
[*] A sound effect now plays when Protection is lost due to an enemy attack.
[*] In order to open room for more varied Mage Titles, and to make the Titles more consistent with their characteristics, Title names, unlock conditions, and characteristics of some Mage Titles will be changed.
[list]
[*] Warrior Titles
[list]
[*] Hitman: Backstab Power +3.75%
[*] Assassin: Backstab Power +5.62%
[*] Nightblade: Backstab Power +7.5%
[/list]
[*] Cleric Titles
[list]
[*] Nurse: Rescue Speed +16%
[*] Chirurgeon: Rescue Speed +24%
[*] Savior: Rescue Speed +32%
[/list]
[*] Mage Titles
[list]
[*] Tamer: Familiar Cooldown -2%
[*] Summoner: Familiar Cooldown -4%
[*] Conjurer: Familiar Cooldown -6%
[*] Spiritcaller: Familiar Cooldown -8%
[*] Occultist: Familiar Attack Power +5%
[*] Diabolist: Familiar Attack Power +7.5%
[*] Demon Ruler: Familiar Attack Power +10%
[/list][/list]
[*] New talents will be added.
[list]
[*] Enhanced Backstrike
[*] Servant Cooldown Down
[*] Aim Move Speed Up
[/list]
[*] Tips will be added on the loading screen. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] As Perks with continuous effects (such as those that boost max HP) are no longer affected by the Cleric Skill Dispel as this allows players to gain Valor points multiple times.
[*] It will now be possible to activate the Cleric Skill Warp Gate even if another warp gate created by a member of the same Squad exists on the battlefield.
[list]
[*] If triggered, other warp gates created by Squad mates will be destroyed.
[/list]
[*] The performance of Warp Gate has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Warp Gate will be made easier to use by adjusting the cooldown and cast time. The duration will also be adjusted so that it is recognized as a target that can be destroyed.
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 30s→20s
[*] Cast time: 6s→3s
[*] Duration: 25/30/35/40/45⇒60/90/120/150/180
[/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Holy Protection has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Due to the lower effectiveness and decreased usage of Holy Protection compared to other abilities, adjustments will be made to enhance its effects. Simultaneously, to clearly define Holy Protection's role in supporting allied players, the Additional Armor granted to oneself will be half of the regular effect.
[list]
[*] Additional Armor: 10/20/30/40/50→20/40/60/80/100
[*] The Additional Armor granted to oneself is halved
[list]
[*] If Harvest Dance's Additional Armor is also granted to oneself, the effect is halved
[/list][/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Whirlwind has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Adjustments will be made to Whirlwind as its damage output was low compared to CP and skill cooldown times.
[list]
[*] CP: 45/60/110/155/175 → 30/60/100/115/125
[/list]
[*] Attack: 10/10.75/13.25/15.5/16.5 → 15/17.25/20.25/21.38/22.12
[*] Demolition: 10/10.75/13.25/15.5/16.5 → 15/17.25/20.25/21.38/22.12
[/list]
[*] The performance of Ice Spear has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] By combining it with other ice attribute skills, Freeze values will be added to enhance its effectiveness.
[*] When the Freeze value reaches a certain level, it will enter a frozen state.
[/list]
[*] The performance of Ice Missile has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] By combining it with other ice attribute skills, Freeze values will be added to enhance its effectiveness.
[*] When the Freeze value reaches a certain level, it will enter a frozen state.
[*] As a result, adjustments to the damage amount and cooldown will be made.
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 11s→13s
[*] Attack: 25→20
[*] Demolition: 25→20
[/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Fire Wall has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Previously, there was no warning when activating Fire Wall, and players had limited ways to deal with it. Therefore, we will change it to provide a warning before the activation of Fire Wall. Additionally, we have enhanced the burning effect, reduced the slowing effect, added an impact on physical entities, and extended the activation range, making it more user-friendly.
[list]
[*] CP: 20/35/75/110/125 ⇒ 15/30/45/60/75
[*] Demolition: 0→20
[*] Warning signs have been added
[*] Adjusted to ignite more quickly
[*] Placement range: 25m→35m
[*] Slowing effect: 80%→30%
[/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Wave Blaster has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Due to the small size of low-level Wave Blasters making effective use difficult, size adjustments will be made. Additionally, since the attackable time after staggering was short, stagger duration will be adjusted.
[list]
[*] Size (m):1.5/2.34/2.52/2.58/2.62⇒2/2.46/2.56/2.59/2.62
[*] Increased stagger duration
[/list][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused warp gates to remain in the air if the location where the warp gate was installed was destroyed.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the range of dash slashes to be greater than normal in rare cases.
[*] The bug that caused the victory camera to malfunction under certain conditions on Dawn Bridge B has been fixed.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
