notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

We've released a patch with changes and improvements to gameplay, event functions, UI/UX, training area, and skill balance, as well as a large number of bug fixes.  

[h2]Change of season duration[/h2]
[list]
[*] The end date of the current Season 0 has been changed.
[*] Before change: Ends April 19, 2023, at 9:00 (UTC)
[*] Now: April 25, 2023, 9:00 (UTC)
[/list]
[h2]Additional Functions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Event rules have been added that only certain classes can participate.
[*] Elemental Fury will be held under this rule, in which only Mages can participate.
[*] We hope you will enjoy a different kind of long-distance warfare-oriented Warlander!
[/list]
[h2]Leaver Penalties[/h2]
[list]
[*] Penalties will now be given for exiting from the menu or leaving a game unattended.
[*] Players who do not finish a match properly will not be able to enter the match for a certain period of time.
[*] Players who are repeatedly doing things that are subject to penalties will have their penalties extended and will be restricted from matching for a longer period of time.
[*] We will continue to add new ways of detecting game abandonment (AFK) to penalize.
[/list]
[h2]Voice Macros[/h2]
[list]
[*] Voice macros will no longer be notified to other players if used multiple times in a row.
[*] When using voice macros or markers in succession, callouts and voice macros will no longer play continuously on other players' screens.
[/list]
[h2]Beginner Quests[/h2]
Improved the content of beginner quests.
[list]
[*] Changed the conditions for clearing steps 1-4.
[*] If there is a quest with changed conditions for a step that is currently in progress, the progress with the old conditions will be reset.
[*] If there is a Quest with changed conditions in an already-cleared step, it will remain clear.
[*] This change does not revert the cleared step to an uncleared state.
[/list]
[h2]Keybindings[/h2]
The following key configurations can now be changed:
[list]
[*] Entering additional skills
[*] Cancel a Skill
[*] Re-Deploy
[/list]
[h2]UI/UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New item and title icons now disappear when the cursor is held over them.
[*] Tooltips for Familiars now display attack power against humans and objects.
[*] Changed so that Glamours already installed are also displayed in the list of equipment appearance changes.
[*] The range of emotes that can be set for each voice macro has been increased.
[/list]
[h2]Adjustments to Training Area[/h2]
[list]
[*] BOTs with higher title ranks have been placed in the training area.
[*] Allied BOTs in the training area now participate in team skills.
[*] The behavior of BOTs in the training area when blown away while in guard status has been changed.
[*] Before: After being blown away, the BOT will return to its original position by normal movement.
[*] After change: After being blown away, the BOT will return to its original position while guarding.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Opening Gates[/h3]
[list]
[*] When an enemy player is near and outside the gate, the gate cannot be opened.
[*] The judgment of opening and closing the gate according to the position of the enemy and the player attempting to open the gate will be as follows.
[/list]
[b]The gate can be opened.[/b]
[list]
[*] Opener: Inside the gate -- Enemy: Inside the gate
[*] Opener: Outside of the gate -- Enemy: Inside of the gate
[/list]
[b]Cannot open the gate[/b]
[list]
[*] Opener: Inside the gate -- Enemy: Near and outside the gate
[*] Opener: Outside of the gate -- Enemy: Near and outside of the gate
[/list]
[h3]Tower Capture [/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now earn Valor points even when you reduce the control meter of an enemy Tower.
[*] The number of Valor points earned when capturing a Tower has been adjusted from 50 to 40 points.
[*] The behavior of BOTs during a match has been improved.
[*] Enemy players in your castle will always be shown on the map.
[/list]
[h2]Skill Balance[/h2]
[h3]Thunderstorm[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stormbringer's ULT "Thunderstorm" now grants 200 armor to the caster.
[/list]
[h3]Dispel[/h3]
[list]
[*] When using Dispel on Firewall, it is now possible to erase the entire firewall.
[/list]
[h3]Fog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fog has been adjusted from 15s to 18s because of its short cool time and wide range, which had a greater impact on the battlefield than expected.
[*] Cool time: 15s to 18s
[*] The range of the effect has been reduced at all levels.
[/list]
[h3]Crystal Defender[/h3]
The following adjustments have been made to the Crystal Defender, which had a short cool time, making it easier to activate multiple times in a single battle.
Cooldown: 6s to 18s

[h3]Healing[/h3]
The following adjustments have been made to the Valor Points earned when healing an allied player, as it was an easier way to earn Valor Points than to use other actions.
The amount of Valor points earned has been decreased from 60 to 50.

[h2]Team Play[/h2]
In order to evaluate actions that contribute to the team from various perspectives, the following evaluation items have been added:
[list]
[*] When a player grants Holy Armor to a teammate, he or she receives Valor points.
[*] However, players do not earn Valor points when they grant Holy Armor to themselves or before the start of a match.
[*] Dispelling an enemy's object born from a Skill or Protection on an enemy will earn you Valor points.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the tooltip of guard shooting sometimes did not show the attack power.
[*] Fixed a bug where the breakdown of Valor points of mercenaries was not displayed in the results.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the season rank progress gauge to show unnatural behavior under certain conditions in results.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the required CP value displayed in the tooltip in results was displayed as lvl 1 regardless of the actual level.
[*] Fixed a problem in which alliance status was not synchronized across players in rare cases.
[*] Fixed a problem in which players' Valor points in a match were sometimes not synchronized properly.
[*] Fixed a problem in which Valor points for capturing a Tower could be earned repeatedly under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the key help message "Close the gate" would sometimes appear when the winch was deactivated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the display of the anti-object attack power of Powerbomb was displayed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the beginner quest would not be cleared even if an emote was performed during the victory or defeat staging.
[*] Fixed a problem in which it appeared that the maximum number of skills and talents could be obtained in the result rewards.
[*] Fixed an issue where a long wait time would sometimes occur when purchasing items in the store in succession.
[*] Fixed a problem in which some reward images were not displayed on the Season Pass screen.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause members of an army to be separated from party members after being matched together.
[*] Fixed an issue where the robot would sometimes stay floating when it landed.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the HP of the player on the robot was sometimes displayed incorrectly when the player was on the robot.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the camera to behave incorrectly when a player lost a match while falling.
[*] Fixed a problem in which some traces of Sentry Anti Cheat remained after uninstalling Warlander. While these files were not functional and totally harmless, the un-clean uninstall was not intended and was also misleading. 
[*] Fixed a problem in which the player could be attacked by the Crystal Defender even if he or she guarded against it.
[*] Some text has been corrected.
[*] Fixed some sound effects.
[/list]
[b]We were able to identify and fix many bugs through reports and communications from our players.
Thank you for your cooperation in improving the game.[/b]

And of course, thank you for your continued support of Warlander.

notes.title: ⚔️ WARLANDER PATCH 1.1.2.975 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

We've released a patch with improvements to the [b]5-Army matchmaking system[/b], [b]Quests & Missions[/b], and [b]more![/b]

[h3]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  AFK players who have not acted for a certain period of time will be removed from the Battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Catapults can no longer be destroyed when an allied player is on board.

[i]AFK and leaver penalties are planned to be added soon.[/i]

[h3]QUESTS & MISSIONS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Adjustments to the difficulty of various quests have been made. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] The quest to get Headshot kills have been removed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] The quest to invoke a cataclysm has been removed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Quest to use finishers have been removed from daily quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Spec Ops mission to Invoke a cataclysm has been changed to “Control 5 or more towers at the same time.”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Point rewards for various Spec Ops missions have been adjusted:

[b]Dawn Bridge[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Control 4 or more towers at the same time 800 → 400
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Control 5 or more towers at the same time 800 → 1200

[b]Pentagon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Control 4 or more towers at the same time 800 → 400
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Control 5 or more towers at the same time 800 → 1200

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Spec Ops mission “Fire 15 or more rounds from the catapult” will now succeed if any members of the Army fire a total of 15 rounds between them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] The HP at which Finishers can be executed has been adjusted. (Was 40 HP → Now 60 HP)

[h3]MATCHMAKING IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

Improved the 5-Army Battle matchmaking to make full battles of 100 players more likely. There may be a longer queue time as a result of this.
[b]Take advantage of this opportunity to enjoy a large-scale match with up to 100 players![/b]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Fixed a problem in which the ‘Item list’ was not displayed correctly in the ‘Loadout’ category of the Shop Menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Fixed an issue preventing purchases from Vietnam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img]  Various text fixes.

notes.title: ⚔️ WARLANDER PATCH 1.1.0.932 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[h1]PATCH 1.1.0.932[/h1]

[h2]GAME ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[h3]Commander[/h3]
The Commander and their Squad can now vote on the role of their Squad and are not automatically assigned Castle Guard. 

[h3]Cataclysms[/h3]
Cataclysms will now appear in a location that considers not only player positions, but also considering Tower control.

[h2]ITEM & EQUIPMENT SELL PRICE ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[h3]Sell melee and ranged weapons at the following prices:[/h3]
Common: 50 Silvings → 90 Silvings
Rare: 140 Silvings → 270 Silvings
Prestige: 320 Silvings → 630 Silvings
Mythic: 660 Silvings → 1320 Silvings

[h3]Sell Shields and Familiars at the following prices:[/h3]
Common: 40 Silvings → 70 Silvings
Rare: 110 Silvings → 220 Silvings
Prestige: 250 Silvings → 550 Silvings
Mythic: 530 Silvings → 1060 Silvings

[h3]Sell Armor Parts at the following prices:[/h3]
Common: 30 Silvings → 50 Silvings
Rare: 80 Silvings → 160 Silvings
Prestige: 190 Silvings → 380 Silvings
Mythic: 400 Silvings → 790 Silvings

[h2]SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] "Switch Style" has been added to the key configuration options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] The mouse wheel input in the key configurations menu can now distinguish between up and down directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] An error code is now displayed when purchasing fails.

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed a bug that caused a user's rank to be displayed incorrectly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] [b]Players can now view the following rankings:[/b]

Ranking: Up to 100 users above or below self.

Top ranking: Up to the top 500 players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed a problem in which mouse input could not be assigned to some key configurations in the options screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed a problem in which mouse sensitivity settings in the options screen were not reflected on the kill camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed an issue where the achievement "Fierce Veteran" would not be unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed an issue where the quest list on the results screen could not be scrolled through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Various text fixes.

Thanks for your continued patience, love, and support.

notes.title: ⚔️ WARLANDER PATCH 1.0.2.909 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[h2]PATCH 1.0.2.909[/h2]

[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]
[h3]Matchmaking Adjustments[/h3]
An update to the matchmaking system has been implemented to make it easier to be matched with players of similar ranks, taking into account the current player population.

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
After analyzing the data obtained so far, it was found that the tempo of game progression was a little slower than expected.

Also, since it was more difficult than expected to break into the castle by using ladders, the following adjustments will be made while taking into consideration the balance with other siege weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Castle door durability: decreased from 1500 to 800.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Ladder durability: Increased from 120 to 300.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Adjusted the number of protective doors in each lane in the 2-Army Battle map: Ritual Valley.

[h2]Item Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Glamour Rarity[/h3]
Equipment can now have any compatible Glamour applied to it regardless of rarity. 

The previous restriction was intended to allow players to judge the strength of equipment to some extent by its appearance.

However, we have removed this restriction so that players can enjoy customizing their equipment more freely.

[h2]Shop Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Mercenary Contracts[/h3]
The prices of Mercenary Contracts have been lowered so that players who have just started the game can purchase them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Rank 3: 450 Silvings → 50 Silvings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Rank 4: 630 Silvings → 100 Silvings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Rank 5: 900 Silvings → 300 Silvings

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed a bug in 2-Army Battle mode: The oil pot at Dawn Bridge was not being hit by projectiles from certain angles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png[/img] Fixed a bug that prevented some Familiars from appearing as post-battle results rewards.

notes.content:
[h1]Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.6.626[/h1]

[h3][b]Greetings Warlander![/b][/h3]
Our next balance and improvement patch is now available! 
This includes improvements to matchmaking, as well as various bug fixes based on your collective feedback. 
 
Join the discussion in Discord. https://discord.gg/playwarlander

[b]Matchmaking System[/b]
We have implemented a system that divides players into armies based on each player's past performance. 
[list]
[*] Teams will be divided based on the winning percentage of the past 10 rounds.
[*] This is meant to help addresses team composition.
[/list]
5-army battles now open once every 19 minutes instead of being always open.
[list]
[*] After 19 minutes have elapsed, the mode is opened for 1 minute.
[*] The layout of the Game Mode selection has been adjusted accordingly.
[*] The time until 5-army battles open matchmaking is indicated on the Play button and on the game mode selection button, when a 5 Army Battle is selected as the game mode.
[/list]
[b]Character Actions[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Sprint being interrupted by some voice macros or setting markers.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Lunge Slash passing through walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where the travel distance for Lunge Slash Lv5 was shorter than Lv4. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the amount of damage from Magic Napalm was different than indicated. 
[*] Fixed an issue where skill EXP values were displayed incorrectly when skills were acquired on the results screen. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the animation of power bombs was impacted by lag. 
[*] Changed call timing of game start API. Server load reduction support has been implemented. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused parties to break up on rare occasions.
[/list]
Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.5.580
notes.content:
[h1]Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.5.580[/h1]

[h3][b]Greetings Warlander![/b][/h3]
Our next balance and improvement patch is now available! 
This includes balance adjustments, as well as some improvements based on your feedback, including adding a Report Player button to the Support screen, adding an option to turn ON/OFF camera shake, adding server selection to the options menu (players may now select the server they wish to prioritize for matchmaking - Please keep in mind that this may affect queue times), and title acquisition cutscenes can now be skipped.
 
Join the discussion in Discord. https://discord.gg/playwarlander

[b]Improvements to the 2-Army Battle Map[/b]
Previously the catapult area and the central area were connected, easily allowing an army that captured the central area to also capture the catapult shortly afterward, making it difficult for opposing armies to mount a comeback.

Therefore, based on community feedback, as well as data obtained from the OBT, we have now separated the central area and the catapult area topographically and added new towers to the catapult routes.

We believe that this clarifies the role of each route and changes how each route influences the overall battle. Please give the map changes a try and let us know what you think. 

[b]Game Rules[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new mechanic that determines the spawn point of the Cataclysmic Idol based on the battle situation and player locations. 
[*] In order to increase the number of Valor Points earned by Catapult operators, we have increased the amount of Valor Points gained when destroying Ballistas and Cannons.
[*] New objectives for each Squad Role
[*] Assault Squads: Damage an enemy Core (more Valor Points received than Spec Ops Squads and Castle Guard that do the same)
[*] Spec Ops Squads: Damage an enemy Core/defeat enemies near the catapult/defeat enemies around your Castle
[*] Castle Guard Squads: Defeat enemies around the castle (more Valor Points received than Assault and Spec Ops Squads that do the same)
[*] Adjusted the number of Valor Points earned from 800 to 1000 for each unit mission completed by Special Ops Squads.
[*] Added a feature that allows a player to instantly Redeploy after a certain amount of time has passed from their death.
[*] Fixed an issue in 2-Army Battles where players could earn more Valor points than usual by destroying and rebuilding the ladder attached to the wooden fort on the stone bridge.
[/list]

[b]Robot[/b]
[list]
[*] Sped up melee attack slightly
[*] Machine gun damage increased from 20 to 30
[*] Cannon damage increased from 60 to 100
[/list]

[b]Hymn of War[/b]
[list]
[*] Shortened casting time.
[/list]

[b]UI/HUD[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved HUD for Core HP display at the top center of the screen.
[*] Added an animation for when the Core is struck by an attack.
[*] Added a button on the support screen that leads to the Report Player page.
[*] Added an option to turn ON/OFF camera shake.
[*] Added server selection to the options menu.
[*] Users may select the server they wish to prioritize for matchmaking.
[*] Title acquisition cutscenes can now be skipped.
[*] Added description of Servant effects in the Servant tutorial.
[*] Added tutorial for Perk levels for Perks attached to equipment
[*] Rerolled Perks are now guaranteed to be different from the Perk that was rerolled.
[*] Added Emote sample playback function on the Emote menu screen.
[*] Number and price of aura crystals available for purchase have been adjusted.
[*] Changed standard price setting from 500 Silvings to 1000 Silvings
[*] Reversed camera controls selected in options are disregarded when using the mouse.
[*] Other minor UI/HUD improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Character's style to be the same as the previously deployed character's when redeploying.
[*] Fixed a bug where the English skill descriptions for Lunge Slash and Magic Napalm were different from their actual effects.
[*] Fixed a bug in which key configuration changes were not reflected in the voting HUD, basic control HUD, or key prompts.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from boarding a siege-weapon when they were disconnected from the network.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where siege-weapons destroyed while on fire could no longer be built.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented users from clicking the EULA approval button.
[*] Improved stability of full-screen mode behavior on monitors of sizes other than 16:9.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued feedback and support! 

⚔️  Your Warlander Team  🛡️

notes.content:
[h1]Open Beta Balance Patch - 0.8.3.529[/h1]
[h3][b]Greetings Warlander![/b][/h3]
Our tuning patch is now live! As previously mentioned, this patch addresses a ton of the feedback and suggestions that we have seen so far from the community and from our own experience playing in the OBT.
 
[b]Please note:[/b] there are some updates to the patch notes and to the contents of the patch since we shared it on Friday.

Join the discussion in Discord. https://discord.gg/playwarlander

[b]Title Characteristics, Perks and Buffs[/b]
[list]
[*] The effects of some Title perks have been changed.
[*] The effect of the building speed buff was reduced.
[/list]

[b]Game Rules[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the appearance of Cataclysmic Idols outside of the central area in 2-army battles.
[*] Cataclysmic Idols are now announced 15 seconds before the idol appears on the map.
[*] Adjusted the number of Valor points gained when a friendly player is healed from 40 to 60.
[*] Raised the number of Valor points earned when completing Castle Guard Squad missions
[*] Raised the number of Valor points earned when defeating a player with a higher ranked 
[/list]

[b]Siege/Anti-siege Weapons[/b]

[list]

[*] Damage decay distance: Adjusted from 25m to 50m
[/list]

[olist]
[*] Removed bullets reaching the catapult in 2-team battles. This was not intended. 
[*] HP increased from 300 to 400
[*] Damage to objects increased from 400 to 500
[/olist]

[b]Catapult[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the interval between shots 3.75s → 4s
[/list]

[b]Basic actions [/b]
[b]Warrior and Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Warrior and Cleric normal attack damage against humans and objects has been reduced.
[/list]

[b]Crossbows[/b]
[b]Hunting Bow[/b]
[list]

[*] Damage to humans and objects: 48 → 44

[b]Wind Blast[/b]

[*] Damage to objects: 30 → 24

[list]

[/list]

[b]Lightning Shock[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that more bullets than expected were being fired in a single shot.
[*] Firing interval 0.6s → 1.25s
[/list]

[b]Ignition[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage to opponents/objects adjusted from 84 to 77
[*] The hardness frame on hit has been reduced.
[/list]

[b]Skills[/b]
[b]Power Bomb[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted damage to humans/objects for each level as follows

Level1 120→60
Level2 144 -> 84
Level3 168→108
Level4 192 to 132
Level5 216→156

[b]Smash[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage to 40 for each level.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed hitbox

Level1 80→60
Level2 100→72
Level3 120 to 84
Level4 140 to 96
Level5 160 to 108

[b]Rushdown[/b]
[list]

Level2 140→112
Level3 180→144
Level4 220 to 176
Level5 260→208

[list]

[/list]

Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

We have a tuning patch ready for testing that will address a ton of the feedback and suggestions that we have seen so far from the community and from our own experience playing in the OBT. notes.title: Open Beta Patch - 0.8.2.525
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

We have released a small patch that fixes a few community-identified issues. 

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game will not start if the installation path breaks due to specific characters being included. This is related to Sentry Anti Cheat issues and should solve the install and launch problems.

[*] Shortened the maximum waiting time to load data when starting a match.
  
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the load-out screen to become inoperable when an error occurred.
[/list]

Your feedback is greatly appreciated!  

To report technical issues please create a ticket with [url=https://playersupport.plaion.com//hc/en-us/categories/6140127738781-WARLANDER]PLAYER SUPPORT [/url]

To suggest features or report bugs please head over to our [url=https://playersupport.plaion.com//hc/en-us/categories/6140127738781-WARLANDER]FEATURE UPVOTE SITE[/url]

Your Warlander Team
